mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dividend_event (symbol, market, ex_dividend_date, payment_date, dividend_per_share, currency, source) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{exDividendDate}, #{paymentDate}, #{dividendPerShare}, #{currency}, #{source}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE market = VALUES(market), payment_date = VALUES(payment_date), dividend_per_share = VALUES(dividend_per_share), currency = VALUES(currency), source = VALUES(source)

INSERT INTO dividend_event (symbol, market, ex_dividend_date, payment_date, dividend_per_share, currency, source) VALUES
